unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: They're my grandparents. They're my father's parents.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: grand（宏大的）+ parent（父母）= 宏大父母的父母，即祖父母。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What does family mean to you?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 米(mean)饭的意思是什么？

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: your grandmother's husband
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: “害怕死斑(husband)”的丈夫。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Oh, these ping-pong bats are nice.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 蝙蝠(bat)拿着球拍(bat)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Well, this is my ping-pong bat.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: ping-pong（乒乓）+ bat（球拍）合成乒乓球拍。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Do you often play ping-pong together?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: play（玩）加 ping-pong（乒乓球）就是打乒乓球。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Do you often play ping-pong together?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: to（去）+ get（得到）+ her（她）= 一起去找她。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Yes, we play every day.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: every（每个）+ day（天）= 每天（注意是两个词）。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Whose fishing rods are those?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: fish（鱼）变 fishing（钓鱼）+ rod（竿）= 钓竿。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: He spends a lot of time fishing.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: s + pend（悬挂）= 花费时间像悬挂着流逝。

unit_vocabulary.comparison: a lot of vs a little
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: He spends a lot of time fishing.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: a lot of 就像 “许多的” 物品堆成山。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: She can play it really well!
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: real（真实的）+ ly（副词后缀）= 真正地，非常。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Family member
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: mem（记忆）+ ber = 家庭成员要牢记在心。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Activity
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: active（活跃的）名词化为 activity（活动）。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Sam is seven, and he really likes chess.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 车(chess)下国际象棋。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: like Chinese chess
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: Chinese（中国的）+ chess（象棋）= 中国象棋。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: He is really funny, and he often makes us laugh.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: fun（有趣）+ ny = 好笑的，滑稽的。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: v. 笑;发笑 n. 笑声
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: He is really funny, and he often makes us laugh.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 拉夫(laugh)听到笑话哈哈大笑。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: My sister looks very different.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: diff（不同）+ fer + ent = 不同的。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I also like playing tennis.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 歪(vi) o 霖(lin)在拉小提琴。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We are all different, but we have a lot of fun together.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: have（拥有）+ fun（乐趣）= 玩得高兴。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I'm the one with the pink hat.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 戴着帽子(hat)去打(hit)……

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: He's very handsome.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: hand（手）+ some（一些）= 手巧又英俊的男士。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: My little brother, Sam, is on his knee.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: k 不发音，nee 读如“尼”，用膝盖跪着。

unit_vocabulary.comparison: at night vs in the day
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: She always reads me a story at night.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: at（在……时）+ night（夜晚）= 在夜晚。

unit_vocabulary.comparison: in the middle vs in the front
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: My grandparents, Jack and Sarah, are in the middle.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: in the（在……里面）+ middle（中间）。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: My grandparents have three grandchildren.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: grand（孙辈）+ child（孩子）= 孙子或孙女。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Fred is Jack and Sarah's son.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 儿子(son)就像家里的太阳(sun)一样。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: v. & n. 远足;徒步旅行
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: She likes to go hiking.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 嗨客(hike)去远足旅行。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: She likes to go hiking.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: go（去）+ hiking（远足）= 去远足。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Next to him is my mum.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: next（下一个）+ to（朝向）= 紧挨着，在旁边。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What does family mean to you?
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: Father And Mother I Love You (F-A-M-I-L-Y) = 家。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Bring a family photo to class.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 用手机(phone)拍照片(photo)。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 叔父;伯父;舅父;姑父;姨父
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: your aunt and uncle's child
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 安可(uncle)叔叔再来一个。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 姑母;姨母;伯母;婶母;舅母
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: your mum's or dad's sister
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 阿姨(aunt)像蚂蚁(ant)一样勤劳。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: n. 堂兄弟;表兄弟;堂姐妹;表姐妹
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: your aunt and uncle's child
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 靠山(cousin)堂表亲是靠山。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: your grandmother's husband
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: grand（宏大的）+ father（父亲）= 爷爷/外公。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: your mum's or dad's mother
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: grand（宏大的）+ mother（母亲）= 奶奶/外婆。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I have a brother and a sister.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 死死特(sister)的姐妹。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: My little brother, Sam, is on his knee.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 不辣的(brother)亲兄弟。
